usedFor: Spaceinvoices holds the clients, payments and documents, and Calendly makes a booking link with “Create Scheduling Link” after “New Client”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Spaceinvoices, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A booking link is created in Calendly when a client is added in Spaceinvoices.

watchOut: Delete events such as “Client Deleted” also reach “Create Scheduling Link”, so pick “New Client”, not a delete trigger.
